_comment: Zero-shot cell phenotyping with VirTues's own pretrained segmentation head (per Aroj's review on PR #27, notebooks/3_demo_segmentation.ipynb). No training, no folds, no classifier fit -- this runs VirTues's pretrained 9-class semantic head directly and reports its raw predictions. We discard VirTues's own instance-segmentation branch entirely and assign its per-pixel class predictions onto OUR OWN existing segmentation masks (same masks every other method in this benchmark uses), via per-cell majority vote.
_comment_virtues_dir: Requires VirTues's VirtuesSegmentationHead (commit 2c9c6cb on bunnelab/virtues, 2026-xx), which does not exist in the commit pinned for run_virtues.py/run_virtues_sp32.py (414d9bb, used by PR #27) -- that older commit's MultiplexVirtues constructor has an incompatible signature (no 'return_intermediate_layers' support the segmentation head needs). Rather than upgrading the shared checkout and risking a silent regression in the already-reviewed sp32/legacy pipelines, this points at a SEPARATE checkout: a 'git worktree add' of the same bunnelab/virtues repo at origin/main, living at /home/juliaoesterle/VirTues_zeroshot. This second checkout (plus its downloaded checkpoints and a copy of our custom cHL marker_embeddings) is NOT tracked by any git repo and will need the same manual transfer to Helix as the original VirTues checkout.

defaults._comment_cell_type_mapping: Fixed architectural output of the sp32 segmentation head (dim_out=5 instance channels, discarded here + num_celltypes=9 semantic channels), per notebooks/3_demo_segmentation.ipynb. Not configurable -- a different checkpoint's head would need its own entry in CHECKPOINT_HEADS in run_virtues_zeroshot.py.

immucan._comment_ground_truth_to_virtues9class: PROPOSED DEFAULT, NOT YET CONFIRMED by Lukas/Aroj -- a many-to-one harmonization of IMMUcan's 14 classes onto VirTues's own fixed 9-class zero-shot vocabulary (needed to score the raw predictions at all). Treg collapsed into 'CD4 T cell' (Tregs are a CD4+ subset). NK_cell, BnT, Plasma_cell and undefined have no clean biological match in VirTues's 9 classes and are mapped to 'Unknown' as the least-wrong option, not because they mean the same thing -- flag before using any resulting accuracy/F1 for the manuscript. 'undefined' specifically is NOT dropped (kept as a real class per Lukas's standing instruction), just mapped into the closest available bucket.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_ground_truth_to_virtues9class: PROPOSED DEFAULT, NOT YET CONFIRMED by Lukas/Aroj -- see immucan's comment for the same caveat. Endothelial maps cleanly to 'Vessel / Endo.'. M1/M2_Macrophage both collapse into 'Myeloid'. NK_cell and undefined have no clean match and are mapped to 'Unknown' as the least-wrong option.
